card.name: Inside hypothetical, counterfactual statements
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a hypothetical or 'would/could/if' sentence, such as the verb after 'might' or 'would', or 'if' and the subject after it. Mostly general web prose.

modes.label: After modal verbs
modes.description: The word right after or at 'might', 'would' or 'could' in a speculative sentence.
modes.example: If you are what you eat, you might<< be>> having an identity crisis.

modes.label: Inside if-clauses
modes.description: 'if' or the words right after it in a counterfactual condition.
modes.example: The constant force of gravity on Earth gives us different results than we would get if<< we>> played sports in space.

modes.label: Stray punctuation
modes.description: Occasional commas or brackets in technical text with no clear hypothetical link.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of an 'if... would' style speculation, once the hypothetical has already been set up.
